scope: Theory-first ideal axial field design: solve first-through-third spatial timing coefficients as a linear system, derive field lengths from the positive inverse-field solution, rank by exact population variance, then independently confirm direct FWHM. Fixed 100 Th source slope, center velocity, 10 m/s Gaussian residual, 2000 V center static energy, reflectron lengths and field-free paths from the reference; accelerator lengths and field ratios change. Symmetric first field zone is an explicit design-family choice, not a universal restriction. Numerical search domain is not a physical upper bound. No 3D, real measurement, physical collection or global-maximum claim.
